_meta.title: Effects starter database
_meta.purpose: Function-to-effect mapping for TRIZ synthesis: given a required function, find candidate physical, chemical, or geometric effects that deliver it.
_meta.provenance: Repository-authored summaries of established phenomena. External reference text is not reproduced. Every selected typing names a specific external reference; references do not establish every legacy application hint.
_meta.usage: Search all installed packs with triz_effects. Categories organize retrieval; related_effects records useful general/special-case links. Typings are explicit hypotheses, not sufficiency verdicts.

audit.scope: Screened the original 60 entries for obvious conflation, misleading guarantees, classification errors and retrieval gaps; targeted source checks support corrections and additions.
remaining_gaps: Opaque optical and field excitations deliberately lack SI dimensions until their quantitative interpretation is selected.
Each typing selects one unary clause, holding other inputs as stated assumptions; multi-input, quantitative and application-specific implementations remain expert work.
Conditional typings and targeted references are not independent expert validation of every legacy statement or application hint.

typing.source: Existing statements/functions and linked references, with SI declarations cross-checked against NIST SP 811.
typing.scope: One selected input/output clause per effect; conditions name other resources, operating assumptions and history. Endomorphisms are generators, not identities. No behavior, dynamics, feasibility, efficiency or sufficiency is inferred.

definitions.scope: Shared interfaces reduce duplicate declarations; named cases retain their complete evidence and assumptions. No independent physical law or behavior is eliminated by interface sharing.

recent_patent_validation.scope: Selected contracts and finite state/probability examples; no complete claim or measured performance validation.
